newsitem.title: GERMANY: Reuters German Advertising & Media Digest - Aug 15.
newsitem.headline: Reuters German Advertising & Media Digest - Aug 15.

text.p: REUTERS GERMAN ADVERTISING & MEDIA DIGEST
News from Reuters and the German press on Advertising, Media, Brand-name
Products and Consumer Trends
ADVERTISING & MEDIA:

WIESBADEN - OWM, the association of German advertisers, attacks television channels for hiking advertising rates during tough economic times. "Ad price increases, which lead to more money being paid for the same services, threaten to throw the advertising business out of balance," the OWM says.
(Reuters)

BERLIN - German film director Volker Schlondorff says he is stepping down as managing director of Babelsberg Film Studios, but will continue to serve as a member of the board for an additional five years. (Variety)

BERLIN - N-TV, the Berlin-based private TV news station, is reorganising programming beginning next month. It will offer more live reports from the stock exchange and longer talk shows and topic-based programming in the evening. Frankfurt agency Alexander Demuth will design the ad campaign for the new programming. (Reuters)

FRANKFURT - Music TV station Viva and teen magazine Bravo, from Heinrich-Bauer-Verlag publishing house, confirm they have begun broad-based cooperation including the launch of new media formats, digital products and cross-promotional activities. (Horizont)
BRAND-NAME PRODUCTS & MARKETS:
BONN - Thomy, Nestle's German unit, says it will fit protective seals on all packaging tubes in a bid to counter repeated threats to contaminate the company's products. (Reuters)

FRANKFURT - Germany's motor vehicle output rose 20 percent in July on a year-on-year basis, rising to 434,000 units, the VDA German vehicle association says. Vehicle output in the first seven months of 1997 was up five percent at 3.03 million units. (Reuters)

FRANKFURT - Westdeutsche Landesbank (WestLB), Germany's largest publicly owned bank, reports a 35 percent rise in first-half operating profit as rallying financial markets boosted trading profits. (Reuters)
FRANKENTHAL - German floor covering manufacturer Tarkett AG says it is on track to merge with Sommer Allibert of France this year despite attempts to block the fusion. (Reuters)
PEOPLE NEWS:
FRANKFURT - Noel Wijsmans is named new marketing director of home furnishing manufacturer Ikea's German unit. He replaces Ola Lindell. (Horizont)
